lead: Friday closed with the state tightening around the labs: [a federal appeals court upheld the Pentagon's Anthropic blacklisting](../summaries/32597850c76c.md), calling Claude a statutorily covered national-security risk, and [Trump ruled out Scott Bessent as 'Super Intelligence Czar'](../summaries/acc13934a14a.md) a day after floating him - while [the US stood alone at the UN dismissing AI safety concerns](../summaries/ccdde235b22f.md). The agent stack kept thickening: [Microsoft made its Copilot super app official](../summaries/61f8ba08662d.md), [Meta unveiled Muse Realtime Avatar](../summaries/1c1693983f6a.md) as [a teardown suggested Muse may quietly call OpenAI models](../summaries/b91562b4ca5c.md), and [OpenAI readied a $500/month ChatGPT Pro Max](../summaries/51dd81faba0d.md) while [Nscale raised $3.36B ahead of its IPO](../summaries/3fa9a128c174.md). Underneath it all, the week's refrain - what agents do when nobody watches - got new evidence: [the first company to disclose an agent cyberattack shared its lessons](../summaries/32085b74bdf4.md) and [Anthropic tested agents bargaining for people](../summaries/de6c82620dff.md).
